title: MLflow version string: bump mlflow/version.py VERSION and every package manifest, JS constant, Java POM and Helm appVersion together, leaving other uv.lock entries alone
answers: After a release, which files hold the MLflow version and do I need to change all of them?
Where is the MLflow Python package version defined, and where does the UI or docs version constant come from?
How do I set the Java SNAPSHOT or R package version for the next development line?
Why does the Helm chart appVersion differ from the dev version in the other files?
body:
Path: The MLflow version is defined in mlflow/version.py:VERSION (Python dev versions use the ".dev0" suffix). The same string is duplicated in pyproject.toml, pyproject.release.toml, libs/skinny/pyproject.toml and libs/tracing/pyproject.toml, in the UI constant mlflow/server/js/src/common/constants.tsx:Version, in the docs constant docs/src/constants.ts:Version, in the Java POMs under mlflow/java (with -SNAPSHOT), in mlflow/R/mlflow/DESCRIPTION, and in charts/Chart.yaml appVersion.
Rule: A dev-version bump changes all of these in one change: the Python and JS/docs strings and the Java/R manifests move to the next development line, while charts/Chart.yaml appVersion is set to the last released version. In pyproject.release.toml, the mlflow-skinny and mlflow-tracing dependency pins must equal the new dev version exactly. In uv.lock, only the editable mlflow package entry's version is updated, not the other locked packages.
Constraints: This covers the version strings only, not the release-branch prod gate in mlflow/releases python.yml or the [tool.mlflow-release] marker. Do not change dependency ranges or extras while bumping the version.
Applies: Version bumps of the MLflow repo after a release, and anyone searching for where the version number lives across Python, UI, docs, Java, R and Helm.

search: Post-release development version bumps require synchronized updates to `mlflow/version.py:VERSION`, package manifests in `pyproject.toml`, `pyproject.release.toml`, `libs/skinny/pyproject.toml`, and `libs/tracing/pyproject.toml`, alongside UI and docs constants, Java POMs, R package metadata, and Helm charts. The Python dev versions use `.dev0`, Java POMs take `-SNAPSHOT`, `charts/Chart.yaml` `appVersion` remains pinned to the last released version, and `uv.lock` updates only the editable `mlflow` entry. Covers version strings and dependency pins between internal packages only, without modifying dependency ranges, extras, release branch production gates, or `[tool.mlflow-release]` markers.
